summary: Full review of inline 3D Blackjack integration on /asiakas (Pisteet → Blackjack subtab). Launch link removed, new bet panel + provably-fair backend wired in, 3D chip stack visible on felt. Backend regression: 13/13 pytest tests still pass (test_blackjack3d.py); coinflip and legacy 2D blackjack endpoints respond OK; standalone /blackjack3d page returns 200. Frontend Playwright run on the live preview URL confirmed: bj3d-launch-link is gone; all bet panel test-ids present (bj-bet-input, bj-bet-slider, bj-chip-25/100/500/1000/clear, bj-preset-select, bj-hint-toggle, bj-start-btn); 2× chip-100 raises bet from 100→300 then clear returns to 10 (min); 'Jaa kortit' starts /api/blackjack3d/round/start, deducts 100 pts from wallet (visible balance pill drops 10520→10420), shows 3D canvas with cards + visible chip stack on the felt; hand pill bj-hand-pill-0 renders '6 · 100p'; Hit/Stand/Double/Surrender enabled, Split correctly disabled with non-pair; Stand triggers settlement and shows '😞 Hävisit -100 pistettä' via #bj-result; bj-verify-btn opens bj-fair-modal in document.body showing commit hash, revealed seed, client seed, nonce, and '✓ Vahvistus onnistui — hash täsmää.' confirming SHA-256 match; 'Uusi kierros' resets panel back to bet selection.

issues: Long hex strings still overflow horizontally on narrow viewports (carried over from iter9, not blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: customer.html is now ~3700 lines — recommend extracting inline Blackjack panel JS (bjReset/renderBjState/doBlackjackStart/doBlackjackAction/bjOpenFairness/_bj3dToFlatState/_bjRenderHandPills + BJ3D scene helpers) into /app/static/js/blackjack3d_inline.js to stay under 700-line guideline.

Insurance prompt (bj-insurance-area) was not exercised in this run because dealer up-card was not an Ace; backend test_action_stand_settles_with_seed_reveal covers the API path. Consider adding a deterministic-seed Playwright test that forces an Ace up-card.

Strategy-hint glow (#bj-hit/#bj-stand/#bj-double boxShadow) — function exists at line ~1895 gated on bj-hint-toggle.checked, but the glow CSS uses inline boxShadow which can be overridden by hover/active states. Not blocking; verified hint toggle persists.

Chip stack visible in deal screenshot at right of player cards on the felt — _addChipStack/setBetVisual upgrade is rendering. Mesh count introspection via window.BJ3D was attempted but the second Playwright run lost auth between renders; the visual verification in screenshot is sufficient evidence.

REGRESSION verified: legacy /api/points/<pid>/blackjack/start still returns a valid game object (kept for backwards compat though no longer called from UI). /api/points/<pid>/coinflip still works. /blackjack3d standalone page still HTTP 200.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (launch link removed, bet panel, deal, settle, fairness, new round)

test_credentials: Player BJ3D Test / test123 / id=1. Topped up to 10520 pts at start (curl /api/players/1/points/grant {count:5000}). Ended ~10420 after one losing 100-pt round.
seed_data_creation: Granted 5000 pts to player_id=1 via /api/players/1/points/grant to ensure sufficient balance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inline 3D Blackjack lives in templates/customer.html under id='gpanel-blackjack'. Test-id prefix is 'bj-' for new controls and 'bj3d-' for canvas badges (bj3d-bet-tag, bj3d-dealer-total). Fairness modal renders into document.body with id='bj-fair-modal'. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_blackjack3d.py run in ~3s and are idempotent. To stress chip-stack growth or insurance path, drive backend with deterministic client_seed to force specific up-cards; the API accepts client_seed in /round/start payload.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects identified. The follow-up integration (1) removed the launch link, (2) replaced inline 2D Blackjack with provably-fair 3D module, (3) wired a visible 3D chip stack — all three goals verified end-to-end.
